replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has reset token in link; weak token forgery attack is concrete and supported."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Immediate login after link click is quoted; mailbox-access-to-session attack is distinct from token guessing."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Public page where user sets new password is quoted; weak password acceptance concrete."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Email-based reset request on internet-facing page supports account enumeration."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Unauthenticated reset request supports email flooding/quota exhaustion; distinct harm."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Design silent on session revocation; attacker retains session after victim reset — concrete."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Token carried in link/URL supported; referrer and log leakage is a distinct attack path."}]}
